body:
## Purpose: It is observed that DeepSeek v4 has numerical issues when passing certain values of `--max-model-len` (e.g., 900000). For instance, the following figure shows the distribution of the number of completion tokens with 100 responses sampled for a selected question from GPQA. It can be seen that the number of generated tokens has a noticeable distribution shift when `--max-model-len 900000` is passed, compared to that not passed. Investigation shows that the root cause is that the indexer persistent topk kernel uses `const int64_t stride = logits.size(1);`. However, the logits produced from [deepgemm's](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepGEMM/blob/891d57b4db1071624b5c8fa0d1e51cb317fa709f/csrc/apis/attention.hpp#L361) `fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits` pads the `max_model_len` dimension to align with 256 and later slices the view to `max_model_len`. Thus, when `max_model_len` is not naturally aligned, the logits become incontiguous, thus the stride calculation is incorrect. This PR fixes this bug. To reproduce the experiment: ``` VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 \ vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro \ --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \ --trust-remote-code \ --block-size 256 \ --no-enable-prefix-caching \ --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","custom_ops":["all"]}' \ --attention_config.use_fp4_indexer_cache True \ --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 \ --tool-call-parser deepseek_v4 \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4 \ --max-cudagraph-capture-size 2048 \ --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 \ --max-model-len 900000 \ --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \ --tensor-parallel-size 8 ``` Set and unset `--max-model-len 900000` to see the difference. Prompt: ``` QUESTION = ( "You have prepared a di-substituted 6-membered aromatic ring compound " "containing 8 carbon atoms in total. Peaks in the FTIR spectrum of this " "compound indicate the presence of a carbonyl group as well as an " "aromatic-halogen bond. Identify the correct 1H NMR data for this compound. \n" "\n" "A) 1H NMR: chemical reference (ppm): 6.9 (1H, s), 4.8 (2H, d), 4.6 (2H, d), 1.3 (2H, s)\n" "B) 1H NMR: chemical reference (ppm): 9.9 (1H, s), 7.8 (2H, d), 7.6 (2H, d), 3.7 (2H, s)\n" "C) 1H NMR: chemical reference (ppm): 4.8 (2H, d), 4.6 (2H, d), 1.3 (3H, s)\n" "D) 1H NMR: chemical reference (ppm): 7.8 (2H, d), 7.6 (2H, d), 2.3 (3H, s)" ) ``` ## Test Plan - Test the num token distribution is normal - Test e2e eval accuracy ## Test Result The figure shows that after applying the patch, the num token distribution becomes normal. In addition, e2e GPQA results: ``` main TP without max-model-len: nemo-run_1/0 ----------------------------------------- gpqa ---------------------------------------- nemo-run_1/0 evaluation_mode | num_entries | avg_tokens | gen_seconds | symbolic_correct | no_answer nemo-run_1/0 pass@1 | 198 | 11754 | 3361 | 89.39% | 0.00% main DEP without max-model-len: nemo-run_1/0 ----------------------------------------- gpqa ---------------------------------------- nemo-run_1/0 evaluation_mode | num_entries | avg_tokens | gen_seconds | symbolic_correct | no_answer nemo-run_1/0 pass@1 | 198 | 12232 | 4058 | 88.88% | 0.00% main TP with --max-model-len 900000: nemo-run_1/0 ----------------------------------------- gpqa ---------------------------------------- nemo-run_1/0 evaluation_mode | num_entries | avg_tokens | gen_seconds | symbolic_correct | no_answer nemo-run_1/0 pass@1 | 198 | 25955 | 12300 | 81.82% | 5.05% main DEP with --max-model-len 900000: nemo-run_1/0 ----------------------------------------- gpqa ---------------------------------------- nemo-run_1/0 evaluation_mode | num_entries | avg_tokens | gen_seconds | symbolic_correct | no_answer nemo-run_1/0 pass@1 | 198 | 17770 | 7457 | 89.39% | 0.00% branch TP with --max-model-len 900000: nemo-run_1/0 ----------------------------------------- gpqa ---------------------------------------- nemo-run_1/0 evaluation_mode | num_entries | avg_tokens | gen_seconds | symbolic_correct | no_answer nemo-run_1/0 pass@1 | 198 | 12573 | 3514 | 88.89% | 0.00% branch DEP with --max-model-len 900000: nemo-run_1/0 ----------------------------------------- gpqa ---------------------------------------- nemo-run_1/0 evaluation_mode | num_entries | avg_tokens | gen_seconds | symbolic_correct | no_answer nemo-run_1/0 pass@1 | 198 | 12381 | 4197 | 87.88% | 0.00% ``` ---
Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist - [ ] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)". - [ ] The test plan, such as providing test command. - [ ] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results - [ ] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model.
title: [Bugfix] Fix DeepSeek v4 topk numerical issue for unaligned max-model-len
